description: Named CMS-pattern exemplar beneficiaries. Each scenario is chosen to exercise a specific, publicly-documented V28 behaviour: demographic-only floor, dual premium, disease-interaction additivity, origin-of-entry disabled tracks, and institutional / full-benefit segments. Scores are locked against hccinfhir (pinned version above); drift fails fast.
cms_reference: Scenarios mirror illustrative patterns from the CY2026 CMS Medicare Advantage Rate Announcement (Part C payment) technical notes, V28 segment tables.

scenarios.label: Community Non-dual Aged female, 72yo, no diagnoses
scenarios.cms_pattern: Demographic floor — community non-dual aged female 70-74 band (Table I-7, V28 CNA).

scenarios.label: Community Non-dual Aged male, 72yo, no diagnoses
scenarios.cms_pattern: Demographic floor — male 70-74 band should slightly exceed female (typical V28 CNA).

scenarios.label: Community Full-dual Aged female, 72yo, no diagnoses
scenarios.cms_pattern: Dual-status premium — full-dual aged female 70-74 must exceed her non-dual peer (CMS full-benefit dual adjustment).

scenarios.label: Community Full-dual Aged male, 72yo, no diagnoses
scenarios.cms_pattern: Dual-status premium — full-dual aged male 70-74 (parallel to CFA female check).

scenarios.label: CNA 72yo female + E11.9 (DM, no complications → HCC 38)
scenarios.cms_pattern: Single-HCC additivity — diabetes without complications adds the V28 HCC 38 constrained-family coefficient on top of the demographic floor.

scenarios.label: CNA 72yo female + I50.22 (acute-on-chronic HF → HCC 226)
scenarios.cms_pattern: Single-HCC additivity — CHF HCC 226 added to demographic floor.

scenarios.label: CNA 72yo female + DM + CHF (interaction check)
scenarios.cms_pattern: Two-HCC additivity with interaction — DM (HCC 38) + CHF (HCC 226) exercises the DIABETES_HF_V28 interaction coefficient.

scenarios.label: CNA 72yo female + N18.3 (CKD stage 3 — no V28 HCC)
scenarios.cms_pattern: Negative control — CKD stage 3 is excluded from V28 HCC mapping (not severe enough); score must equal demographic floor.

scenarios.label: CNA 72yo female + J44.9 (COPD → HCC 280)
scenarios.cms_pattern: Single-HCC additivity — COPD V28 HCC 280 on top of demographic floor.

scenarios.label: New Enrollee female, 65yo, non-dual, community
scenarios.cms_pattern: New Enrollee table — female 65 community non-dual (NE V28 Table I-14 structural lock).

scenarios.label: New Enrollee female, 65yo, full-dual, community
scenarios.cms_pattern: New Enrollee dual premium — full-dual NE must exceed non-dual NE at same age/sex.

scenarios.label: New Enrollee male, 66yo, OREC=1 (originally disabled)
scenarios.cms_pattern: OREC track — originally-disabled entrants carry a higher NE coefficient than aged-in peers (CMS NE Table OREC=1 rows).

scenarios.label: CNA disabled male 55yo + DM
scenarios.cms_pattern: Disabled non-aged segment — originally disabled under-65 male with DM (V28 disabled-segment coefficient applies).

scenarios.label: CNA 80yo female with DM + CHF + CKD3 + COPD
scenarios.cms_pattern: Multi-HCC stack — four-condition profile in aged 80-84 band exercises multiple interactions and demographics simultaneously.

scenarios.label: CFA 80yo full-dual female with DM + CHF + CKD3 + COPD
scenarios.cms_pattern: Multi-HCC stack + dual premium — same profile under CFA segment must exceed CNA version (monotonicity invariant).
